title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.21605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. translated_title: ViRA：通过跨输入相对策略优化实现超高分辨率视觉智能体
translated_abstract: 视觉智能体通过放大相关区域来回答关于超高分辨率照片的问题。然而，现有的智能体往往基于常识回答问题，而不是真正阅读图像中的证据。针对最终答案进行强化学习（RL）训练无法纠正这一问题，因为凭空猜测和仔细阅读获得的奖励是相同的。我们提出了跨输入相对策略优化，它在对比集上训练智能体。对比集针对同一图像的多个版本提出同一个问题，这些版本仅在一个包含证据的小区域上有所不同，并且各自有不同的答案，因此只有阅读证据才能正确解决整个集合。CrossRPO奖励解决整个集合的行为，并且我们证明了它不会强化基于常识作答的行为。我们通过在21到120百万像素的图像中编辑一个小物体，构建了用于训练（ViRA-Train）和评估（ViRA-Bench）的对比集，并且我们还拍摄了包含真实变化的更多数据集，以排除编辑痕迹的影响
tldr: 提出跨输入相对策略优化（CrossRPO），通过构造仅局部证据区域不同且答案各异的对比集来训练视觉智能体，使其真正阅读超高分辨率图像中的证据，而不是依赖常识猜测。
en_tdlr: Proposes Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains visual agents on contrast sets—image versions differing only in a small evidence region with different answers—so that agents truly read evidence in ultra-high-resolution images rather than guessing from common sense.
